run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum chocolates distributable equally among k students from an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print the number of successful comparisons
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses prefix sums and remainder hashing to find the longest divisible subarray
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness when finding the maximum subarray sum divisible by k
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python builtins like itertools.accumulate instead of a manual prefix sum loop
